entries.source: Visit Syedra Ancient City from Alanya with hotel transfer, guide service, lunch, entrance ticket and panoramic Mediterranean views. Approximate 9-hour cultural tour.
entries.translation: Visit Syedra Ancient City from Alanya with hotel transfer, guide service, lunch, entrance ticket and panoramic Mediterranean views. Approximate 9-hour cultural tour.

entries.source: Colonnaded Street • Roman Baths • Ancient Cisterns • Mediterranean Panorama
entries.translation: Colonnaded Street • Roman Baths • Ancient Cisterns • Mediterranean Panorama

entries.source: Explore one of Alanya’s most atmospheric archaeological sites, set around 400 metres above the Mediterranean and known for its monumental gate, 250-metre colonnaded street, Roman-period structures and panoramic coastal views.
entries.translation: Explore one of Alanya’s most atmospheric archaeological sites, set around 400 metres above the Mediterranean and known for its monumental gate, 250-metre colonnaded street, Roman-period structures and panoramic coastal views.

entries.source: Syedra Ancient City lies approximately 20 kilometres southeast of Alanya on a hillside overlooking the Mediterranean. The settlement traces its origins to the 7th century BC and reached its most prosperous period between the 2nd and 4th centuries AD.
entries.translation: Syedra Ancient City lies approximately 20 kilometres southeast of Alanya on a hillside overlooking the Mediterranean. The settlement traces its origins to the 7th century BC and reached its most prosperous period between the 2nd and 4th centuries AD.

entries.source: The Upper City stands at an elevation of around 400 metres. Visitors enter through a monumental gate and continue to the approximately 250-metre colonnaded street, once one of the city’s main social spaces.
entries.translation: The Upper City stands at an elevation of around 400 metres. Visitors enter through a monumental gate and continue to the approximately 250-metre colonnaded street, once one of the city’s main social spaces.

entries.source: The archaeological site preserves Roman baths with evidence of mosaic floors, a gymnasium, workshops, numerous plastered cisterns and rock-cut religious spaces. The Cistern Cave and nearby Baptism Cave are among the most distinctive surviving features.
entries.translation: The archaeological site preserves Roman baths with evidence of mosaic floors, a gymnasium, workshops, numerous plastered cisterns and rock-cut religious spaces. The Cistern Cave and nearby Baptism Cave are among the most distinctive surviving features.

entries.source: This tour combines archaeology, mountain scenery and wide Mediterranean views. The terrain is uneven and includes slopes, stone paths and steps, so comfortable non-slip footwear is essential.
entries.translation: This tour combines archaeology, mountain scenery and wide Mediterranean views. The terrain is uneven and includes slopes, stone paths and steps, so comfortable non-slip footwear is essential.
